original_test_intent: Validate the exact leak-detection line asserts the mapped sensor/alarm and approved protective response under a controlled wet stimulus, then deasserts and restores normal operation after verified safe drying.
original_method: Map line/zone/channel and sensor/SEL; isolate dedicated system with containment; qualified operator applies only a vendor-approved simulator or specified test fluid at defined quantity/location/dwell while agent records synchronized telemetry; verify alarm/action timing; remove stimulus and use approved non-damaging drying; independently confirm dryness, deassertion and recovery before re-energization/final state.
manual_activity: Qualified liquid-cooling operator applies/removes the approved stimulus and drying method; agent may collect synchronized sensor/SEL/power evidence.
required_inputs: Leak-line zone/channel and BMC sensor/SEL mapping
Vendor-approved simulator/test fluid, amount, location, dwell and containment
Expected warning/error, action, shutdown-or-other timing and deassert behavior
Dryness verification, electrical isolation, abort, re-energization and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Use dedicated isolated SUT, containment, PPE/ESD and qualified operator
Never drip ordinary water or use uncontrolled hot airflow on live hardware
Set hard electrical/liquid/thermal aborts and independent power control
Do not re-energize until dryness/inspection is approved; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Correlate operator stimulus/dryness markers and final recovery
Do not apply liquid/heat, choose shutdown policy, clear logs, re-energize, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve safe stimulus and leak-line map
Define exact alarm/event and protective-action timing
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command substitutes for the physical line stimulus; telemetry collection is supplemental and automatable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Stream the mapped leak sensor, SEL, alarms and power state around operator-controlled simulator/wet and dry transitions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Wet-line detection, warning/protective response, drying and recovery remain; unsafe literal means are gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an approved leak simulator or metered compatible fluid with containment, synchronized detection/action evidence and verified dry-out.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces uncontrolled water/hair dryer with engineering-approved stimulus, abort and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A manually triggered software alarm may not test line sensitivity; an uncontrolled liquid test creates unacceptable damage risk.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Moisture can wick beyond the sensor and hot air can damage or redistribute it; dryness must be independently established.

project_override_considerations: A vendor electrical/simulator fixture is preferred if it exercises the sensor input without reducing required line coverage; document any physical-coverage difference explicitly.
expected_evidence: Stimulus material/fixture, quantity/location/dwell and containment record
Timestamped warning/event/protective action and shutdown-or-other behavior
Dryness verification, deassertion, recovery/final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently describe wet assertion, protective behavior and dry recovery; the exact method/action are unsafe or unspecified pending inputs rather than contradictory goals.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Manual execution is possible with a vendor-approved safe stimulus and recovery plan; absence of those inputs blocks runtime only.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2275 Wistron-BMC-00694-V003: approve leak-line zone/channel and sensor/SEL mapping; vendor-approved simulator or compatible test fluid, quantity/location/dwell/containment and whether it preserves physical coverage; exact warning/error/severity and protective response (including whether shutdown in one minute is mandatory), timing and aborts; safe drying/dryness verification, electrical isolation, re-energization, deassertion and final recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves leak-line assertion and dry recovery while preventing literal uncontrolled water/hair-dryer execution on live equipment.
independent_technical_reasoning: A leak line is an electrical sensing path whose response depends on fluid conductivity, placement and wetted length. Ordinary water quantity and a hair dryer provide no repeatable stimulus and can spread moisture or heat nearby materials. The case therefore needs a calibrated compatible stimulus or simulator, exact zone/event/action mapping, containment, hard aborts and independent dryness before power recovery. The example shutdown cannot become the oracle until engineering confirms policy.
